no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Do not call fetch directly. All server communication must go through the RTK Query API definition (src/state/api.ts). See Req 15.4.

no-restricted-properties.message: Do not call window.fetch directly. Use the RTK Query API definition (src/state/api.ts). See Req 15.4.

paths.name: axios
paths.message: Do not import axios. All server communication must go through the RTK Query API definition (src/state/api.ts). See Req 15.4.

overrides.comment: RTK Query endpoint definitions are the single allowed place for HTTP client usage (Req 15.4).
